string.name: name
string.value: [C] Nebulite (Recovery MP)

string.name: desc
string.value:
A mysterious stone infused with the power of the aliens. If you insert it into an item's open socket, the stats of the alien stone will be added to the item.

#* Fits on weapons with an empty socket only.
* 3% chance to recover 15 MP when attacking.#
